newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF Trust Fund Bureau says to continue buying JGBs.
newsitem.headline: MOF Trust Fund Bureau says to continue buying JGBs.

text.p: The Japanese Finance Ministry's Trust Fund Bureau will buy Japanese government bonds (JGBs) from the market from December as it has done in the past six months, at similar intervals and in the same amounts, an official at the bureau told Reuters on Thursday.

In June, the bureau said it would resume outright JGB purchases, a practice which it had stopped in 1993, and that it would buy 100 billion yen worth of JGBs from the secondary market twice a month for about six months.
The market has been keen to know whether the bureau would extend its plan beyond December.

The official said that the JGB purchases were aimed at efficient and diverse portfolio management and that there were no policy implications. He said: "The JGB buying is not a measure to prop up the market and the bureau has not attached any policy implications to it," the official said.
